key: 附加問句求確認；Yes, but…＝可以但有但書

notes.o: Yes, but feel free to use it until someone turns up.
notes.why: Yes 確認，並補充有人來之前可以先用

notes.o: We visited the factory last spring.
notes.why: visited 與 visiting 發音相近，講參觀工廠

notes.o: The designer sent three logo options.
notes.why: designer 與 designated 發音相近

key: 附加問句求附和；Especially since＝補充同意的理由

notes.o: The gym equipment is brand new.
notes.why: 重複 equipment，講健身器材，沒回應租賃

notes.o: Especially since we'll only need it for six months.
notes.why: Especially 附和租比較實際，理由是只用半年

notes.o: At least a dozen people signed up.
notes.why: 報名人數與租設備無關

key: A or B 問句；用理由間接選「等到週末」

notes.o: Hold on, I'll transfer your call.
notes.why: Hold on 與 hold off 相近，講電話轉接

notes.o: The site gets the fewest visitors on Sundays.
notes.why: 週日訪客最少 → 暗示等到週末部署影響最小

notes.o: The date on the form is wrong.
notes.why: date 與 update 發音相近，講表格日期

key: 陳述句說問題 → 選提議檢討；turnover＝人員流動

notes.o: The shelf is too high for me to reach.
notes.why: high 指架子高度，不是流動率高

notes.o: Maybe it's time we reviewed the incentive plan.
notes.why: Maybe 提議檢討獎勵制度，回應流動率問題

notes.o: Turn over the page and sign at the bottom.
notes.why: Turn over 是翻頁，不是人員流動 turnover

key: A or B 問句；「平均分」＝兩者都給

notes.o: The center is closed on public holidays.
notes.why: 重複 center，講假日休館，沒做選擇

notes.o: The donors asked us to split them evenly.
notes.why: 平均分配 → 兩邊都給，不是只選一個

notes.o: Please proceed to the front desk.
notes.why: proceed 與 proceeds 相近，講前往櫃台

key: How 問方法；聽動詞進行式的具體作法

notes.o: We're negotiating a bulk rate with another carrier.
notes.why: 說明作法：和別家貨運談大宗優惠費率

notes.o: The ship departs from the harbor at dawn.
notes.why: ship 與 shipping 相近，講船的出發

notes.o: I set it off by accident, sorry.
notes.why: set off 是觸發，不是抵銷 offset

key: What accounts for 問原因；聽差異的具體來源

notes.o: They're in the top drawer of my desk.
notes.why: drawer 是位置，不是差異的原因

notes.o: One of them doesn't include the delivery charge.
notes.why: 指出原因：其中一張沒含運費

notes.o: I opened both accounts at the same bank.
notes.why: accounts 指銀行帳戶，不是 account for

key: Can you 請求；「放桌上我看看」＝願意處理

notes.o: The names are listed in alphabetical order.
notes.why: order 指排序，不是採購單

notes.o: The leaves are turning red already.
notes.why: leaves 與 leave 發音相近，講樹葉

notes.o: Leave it on my desk and I'll look it over.
notes.why: 放桌上我會看 → 答應盡量處理

key: Can…handle 問能否應付；「測試當機」＝不行

notes.o: I ordered the soup and a salad.
notes.why: ordered 指點餐，不是訂單暴增

notes.o: Please handle the boxes with care.
notes.why: 重複 handle，指搬運箱子

notes.o: It crashed twice during last week's test.
notes.why: 測試當機兩次 → 暗示應付不了暴增

key: Why 問原因；聽人力、故障等具體原因

notes.o: By the end of the week at the latest.
notes.why: By the end of week 是期限，不是原因

notes.o: Please log back in and try again.
notes.why: log 與 backlog 的 log 相近，講登入

notes.o: Half the support team is away at an offsite workshop.
notes.why: 說出原因：客服團隊一半的人不在

key: Isn't supposed to 確認預定；回延期＝不是週一

notes.o: The auditorium seats five hundred people.
notes.why: auditorium 與 audit 發音相近

notes.o: The comments were very helpful.
notes.why: comments 與 commence 發音相近

notes.o: The auditors asked to push it back a week.
notes.why: 要求延一週 → 暗示不是下週一開始

key: Do we need 問需不需要；引用規定＝需要

notes.o: I bid on a painting at an auction once.
notes.why: 重複 bid，講競標畫作，沒回答規定

notes.o: The supplies are in the storage closet.
notes.why: supplies 與 supplier 相近，講用品位置

notes.o: Company policy calls for at least three.
notes.why: 規定至少三家 → 暗示需要多家報價

key: 附加問句求確認；說明代理＝不是原定人選

notes.o: The strategy worked better than expected.
notes.why: 重複 strategy，評價策略，沒說誰主持

notes.o: She's on leave, so Mr. Chen is filling in.
notes.why: 她請假、陳先生代理 → 這次不是她主持

notes.o: The facilities include a pool and a gym.
notes.why: facilities 與 facilitate 發音相近

key: Could you 請求；說出具體作法＝答應

notes.o: The interest rate has gone up again.
notes.why: interest 指利息，不是對彈性工時的興趣

notes.o: Your flight departs from gate nine.
notes.why: gate 與 gauge 發音相近，講登機門

notes.o: I'll send out a short survey this afternoon.
notes.why: 答應，並說要發問卷來了解意願

key: Didn't 確認過去經歷；回答細節＝間接肯定

notes.o: She overslept and missed the bus.
notes.why: overslept 與 oversee 的 over 相近

notes.o: I'd like to transfer money to my savings account.
notes.why: transfer 指轉帳，不是調職

notes.o: For about three years, I believe.
notes.why: 回答任期約三年 → 間接肯定她確實管過

key: Does…apply to 問適用對象；說「針對正職」＝不適用

notes.o: It's meant for full-time staff, as I understand it.
notes.why: 只針對正職 → 暗示不適用約聘人員

notes.o: I applied for the position online.
notes.why: applied for 是應徵，不是 apply to 適用

notes.o: The attendance was better than last year.
notes.why: 重複 attendance，講出席人數，沒答適用對象

key: A or B 問句；用班機時間暗示會留下

notes.o: The shop is closing in ten minutes.
notes.why: closing 是打烊，不是閉幕酒會

notes.o: The receptionist is on her lunch break.
notes.why: receptionist 與 reception 發音相近

notes.o: My flight isn't until tomorrow afternoon.
notes.why: 班機明天下午 → 今晚不走，會留下參加

key: 陳述句報喜 → 選表揚、附和的回應

notes.o: I'd like a price quote for this printer.
notes.why: quote 與 quota 發音相近，講報價

notes.o: The team deserves some recognition for that.
notes.why: 附和喜訊：團隊值得表揚

notes.o: The margins on this page are too narrow.
notes.why: margins 指頁面邊界，不是超額幅度

key: 陳述句有但書 → 選補救辦法；lacks＝缺乏

notes.o: The manager's office is down the hall.
notes.why: 重複 manager，講辦公室位置

notes.o: We could pair him with a senior mentor at first.
notes.why: 提出補救：安排導師彌補管理經驗不足

notes.o: I left my credit card at home.
notes.why: credit card 與 credentials 發音相近

key: A or B 問句；「你比我熟」＝請對方自己報告

notes.o: I bought her a present yesterday.
notes.why: present 指禮物，不是做報告

notes.o: The room is about ten meters long.
notes.why: meters 與 metrics 發音相近

notes.o: You know the figures better than I do.
notes.why: 你比我熟 → 暗示由對方自己報告

key: 陳述句描述現象 → 選說明因應作法

notes.o: That's why we bring in seasonal staff.
notes.why: That's why 承接銷量起伏，說明找季節人手

notes.o: I'm spending the holidays with my family.
notes.why: 重複 holidays，講自己的假期，沒回應銷售

notes.o: The sailboat tour leaves at noon.
notes.why: sailboat 與 sales 發音相近

key: Has…finished 問完成沒；要求延期＝還沒完成

notes.o: He's quite a reliable colleague.
notes.why: reliable 與 liability 發音相近

notes.o: They've asked for an extension until Thursday.
notes.why: 要求延到週四 → 暗示還沒評估完

notes.o: The legal department is on the ninth floor.
notes.why: 重複 legal，講部門樓層，沒答進度

key: 陳述句講期限 → 選表達時間緊迫的回應

notes.o: That doesn't leave us much time to run the numbers.
notes.why: 時間不多，不夠把數字算過一遍

notes.o: I usually have lunch around noon.
notes.why: 重複 noon，講午餐時間，沒回應期限

notes.o: The answering machine is full.
notes.why: answering machine 是答錄機，不是答覆

key: When 問時間；「大多兩週內」是期間說法

notes.o: In the training room on the second floor.
notes.why: training room 是地點，不是時間

notes.o: We're boarding at gate twelve.
notes.why: boarding 與 onboarding 發音相近

notes.o: It varies, but most are done within two weeks.
notes.why: 沒給確切日期，但說大多兩週內完成

key: 附加問句確認「交了沒」；缺東西＝還沒交

notes.o: I haven't been to that restaurant.
notes.why: 沒去過餐廳與費用報告無關

notes.o: I'm still missing one hotel receipt.
notes.why: 還缺一張收據 → 暗示報告還沒交

notes.o: The weather report says rain.
notes.why: 重複 report，講天氣預報

key: Weren't…due 問該交了沒；說對方晚交＝還沒交

notes.o: The regional offices were late sending their data.
notes.why: 區域辦公室資料晚交 → 所以數字還沒交

notes.o: The sale ends this Sunday.
notes.why: sale 指特賣，不是 sales figures 銷售數字

notes.o: He's due to arrive at noon.
notes.why: 重複 due，講他預計抵達，主詞也不合

key: Don't you think 徵詢看法；「只是起步」＝不完全同意

notes.o: I'm paying close attention.
notes.why: attention 與 retention 發音相近

notes.o: It's a start, but salaries are the underlying issue.
notes.why: 只是起步，根本問題是薪水 → 不完全同意

notes.o: The staff room is on the left.
notes.why: 重複 staff，講休息室位置，沒表態

key: 陳述句報壞消息 → 選因應行動

notes.o: This sticker won't come off the box.
notes.why: sticker 與 stuck 發音相近，講貼紙

notes.o: The customer left a five-star review.
notes.why: customer 與 customs 發音相近

notes.o: We'd better warn the retailers about a delay.
notes.why: 提議通知零售商延誤，是合理的因應

key: What did…say 問說了什麼；「我先走了」＝不知道

notes.o: I had to leave before she got to that item.
notes.why: 沒聽到她講合併案 → 間接表示不知道

notes.o: The chairs in the boardroom are quite comfortable.
notes.why: chairs 與 chairperson 的 chair 相近，講椅子

notes.o: It's a major road, so traffic is heavy.
notes.why: major 與 merger 發音相近，講幹道

key: Hasn't…finished 問還沒好嗎；等零件＝還沒好

notes.o: The installment is due on the first.
notes.why: installment 與 installing 相近，講分期款

notes.o: They're waiting for a few parts to arrive.
notes.why: 在等零件 → 暗示還沒裝好

notes.o: The new workstations cost about nine hundred dollars each.
notes.why: 重複 workstations，講價格，沒答進度

key: Did…comply 問有沒有遵守；用結果間接回答

notes.o: She specializes in tax law.
notes.why: specializes 與 specifications 發音相近

notes.o: The last three shipments arrived exactly as requested.
notes.why: 最近三批完全照要求 → 暗示有遵守規格

notes.o: The complaint form is on our website.
notes.why: complaint 與 comply 發音相近

key: Should we 問該不該；「等驗證」＝現在先別公開

notes.o: Let's wait until the data has been verified.
notes.why: 等資料驗證 → 暗示現在先不要告知

notes.o: The store closes at nine on weekdays.
notes.why: 店家營業時間與是否告知客戶無關

notes.o: The test was easier than I expected.
notes.why: test 指考試，不是測試結果

key: 陳述句講問題 → 選處理動作；discrepancy＝不符

notes.o: The latest train leaves at midnight.
notes.why: 重複 latest，講末班火車

notes.o: I'll pull up the order and compare the totals.
notes.why: 調出訂單核對總額，是處理不符的做法

notes.o: Her voice is very clear.
notes.why: 聲音清不清楚與發票無關

key: Is…going to 問會不會；「週五才宣布」＝未定

notes.o: The announcement won't be made until Friday.
notes.why: 週五才宣布 → 目前還不確定

notes.o: The event was a great success.
notes.why: success 與 succeed 同字根，講活動成功

notes.o: He gave me clear directions to the station.
notes.why: directions 與 director 發音相近

key: A or B 問句；用條件暗示「會員專屬」

notes.o: We open at eight every morning.
notes.why: 重複 open，講營業時間，沒做選擇

notes.o: You'll need to show a membership card at checkout.
notes.why: 要出示會員卡 → 暗示折扣是會員專屬

notes.o: I can count on him every time.
notes.why: count 與 discount 的 count 相近

key: 附加問句問有沒有違約；「審閱中」＝未定

notes.o: Our lawyers are reviewing the delivery terms now.
notes.why: 律師在審閱 → 目前還不確定有沒有違約

notes.o: The beach is only ten minutes away.
notes.why: beach 與 breach 發音相近

notes.o: They supply paper to most local schools.
notes.why: supply 與 supplier 相近，講供應紙張

key: Who 問人；職稱＋簽核＝回答誰核准

notes.o: He traveled by train both ways.
notes.why: traveled 與 travel 相近，講交通方式

notes.o: The author will sign copies after the talk.
notes.why: author 與 authorized 發音相近

notes.o: His department head signs off on those.
notes.why: department head 是人，簽核表示由他核准

key: 陳述句說問題 → 選推測原因的回應

notes.o: I logged ten hours of overtime last week.
notes.why: logged 指記錄時數，不是登入 log in

notes.o: Your password may have expired.
notes.why: 密碼可能過期，是登入失敗的可能原因

notes.o: The logo looks great on the box.
notes.why: logo 與 log 發音相近

key: How much 問費用；「先查費率」＝現在還不知道

notes.o: My assignment was to call the branch manager.
notes.why: assignment 與 consignment 發音相近

notes.o: Let me check the courier's rate sheet first.
notes.why: 先查費率表 → 現在還不知道價格

notes.o: It should arrive within three business days.
notes.why: 三個工作天是時間，不是費用

key: A or B 問句；回「哪個趕得上就哪個」＝重時效

notes.o: I can see the harbor from my window.
notes.why: 港口與海運相關，沒做選擇

notes.o: Whichever gets them there before the trade fair.
notes.why: 以趕上商展為標準，哪種都行

notes.o: The air conditioner needs to be repaired.
notes.why: air 重複，指冷氣，不是空運

key: Could you 請求；Of course＋直接開始講

notes.o: The late fee is ten dollars.
notes.why: 重複 late，講逾期費，沒回應請求

notes.o: Of course. First, the launch date has moved.
notes.why: Of course 答應，並直接開始講第一點

notes.o: It's impolite to point at people.
notes.why: point 是用手指，不是要點

key: Could you 請求；Sure, once…＝答應但要等

notes.o: Sure, once the last few come in.
notes.why: Sure 答應，但要等最後幾份回覆才做

notes.o: The pile of boxes fell over.
notes.why: pile 與 compile 發音相近，講箱子倒了

notes.o: I'd like a single room, please.
notes.why: 重複 single，講單人房，沒回應請求

key: 附加問句求確認；說「已安排」＝肯定

notes.o: It's a logical conclusion.
notes.why: logical 與 logistics 發音相近

notes.o: I've already set up a weekly call with them.
notes.why: 已約好每週電話 → 肯定會與新加坡聯繫

notes.o: The post office closes at five.
notes.why: 郵局營業時間與聯繫窗口無關

key: 附加問句問「沒豁免吧」；「每棟都要」＝沒豁免

notes.o: Every building on the premises has to be checked.
notes.why: 每棟建築都要檢查 → 暗示我們沒有豁免

notes.o: I made several attempts to call.
notes.why: attempts 與 exempt 發音相近

notes.o: Keep your valuables in the hotel safe.
notes.why: safe 與 safety 相近，講保險箱

key: Are…entitled 問有沒有資格；「只有…時」＝有條件

notes.o: Only when they're visiting a client.
notes.why: only when 表示有條件：只限拜訪客戶

notes.o: The park is lovely in spring.
notes.why: park 指公園，不是停車 parking

notes.o: The title of the report is too long.
notes.why: title 與 entitled 發音相近

key: Haven't…been paid 問還沒付嗎；說對方承諾＝還沒付

notes.o: The client promised a transfer by Friday.
notes.why: 客戶答應週五前匯款 → 目前還沒付清

notes.o: The pay raise takes effect in July.
notes.why: pay 與 paid 相近，講加薪生效

notes.o: Thank you, she did an outstanding job.
notes.why: outstanding 指出色，不是未付

key: 陳述句報好消息 → 選附和、展望的回應

notes.o: That's a good sign for next month's launch.
notes.why: a good sign 附和好消息，並展望上市

notes.o: I'm positive I locked the door.
notes.why: positive 指確定，不是正面

notes.o: I'd like to buy two tickets, please.
notes.why: buy 與 buyers 發音相近

key: A or B 問句；「沒數字沒意義」＝先等結果

notes.o: The committee has seven members.
notes.why: 重複 committee，講人數，沒做選擇

notes.o: Yes, it's very convenient for me.
notes.why: convenient 與 convene 相近；Yes 也不合

notes.o: There's little point in meeting without the numbers.
notes.why: 沒數字開會沒意義 → 暗示等查帳結果

key: Why 問原因；聽瑕疵、延誤等具體原因

notes.o: They sent us a thank-you card last week.
notes.why: 重複 sent，講感謝卡，沒說原因

notes.o: Yes, I typed it up this morning.
notes.why: Why 問句不能用 Yes 回答

notes.o: The engineers found a flaw in the latest test.
notes.why: 說出原因：測試發現瑕疵

key: Could you help 請求；先反問排除步驟＝願意協助

notes.o: Registration closes at five o'clock.
notes.why: Registration 與 register 發音相近

notes.o: I read the card you sent me.
notes.why: 重複 card，講讀卡片，沒回應請求

notes.o: Have you tried restarting it?
notes.why: 先問是否重開機 → 願意協助，先排除簡單原因

key: Wouldn't 否定問句；It would, but…＝同意但有阻礙

notes.o: The ship docks at pier seven.
notes.why: ship 與 shipments 相近，講船靠港

notes.o: The economy class seats were full.
notes.why: economy 與 economical 相近，講經濟艙

notes.o: It would, but the client wants them on separate dates.
notes.why: It would 同意較省錢，but 說明客戶要分開到貨

key: Have you had a chance 問做了沒；等收據＝還沒做

notes.o: I'm still waiting on a few receipts from sales.
notes.why: 還在等收據 → 暗示帳還沒核對完

notes.o: We recycle paper and plastic here.
notes.why: recycle 與 reconcile 發音相近

notes.o: There's a good chance of rain tomorrow.
notes.why: chance 指機率，不是有機會做某事

key: Would you please 請求；Understood＝答應

notes.o: Understood. I'll keep it to myself for now.
notes.why: Understood 答應，暫時不會說出去

notes.o: The road sign was hard to read.
notes.why: sign 與 signed 相近，講路標

notes.o: Please hold the elevator for me.
notes.why: hold 與 withhold 相近，講按住電梯

key: Where 問去哪找；說「還在整理」＝暫時找不到

notes.o: It lasted about ninety minutes.
notes.why: minutes 指分鐘，不是會議紀錄

notes.o: Ms. Lin is still typing them up.
notes.why: 還在打字整理 → 暗示紀錄暫時還沒有

notes.o: I was so bored I nearly fell asleep.
notes.why: bored 與 board 發音相近

key: 陳述句說不滿 → 選說明原因的回應

notes.o: Please share the document with everyone.
notes.why: share 與 shareholders 相近，講分享文件

notes.o: We divided the bill equally.
notes.why: divided 與 dividend 發音相近，講平分帳單

notes.o: With profits down, a smaller payout was inevitable.
notes.why: 說明原因：獲利下滑，股利變少免不了

key: 陳述句報設備故障 → 選建議報修

notes.o: The train station is two blocks away.
notes.why: 火車站距離與冷氣故障無關

notes.o: You should report that to the facilities team.
notes.why: 建議向設施組報修，回應冷氣故障

notes.o: Please shut the door behind you.
notes.why: shut 重複，講關門，沒回應故障

key: 附加問句問「沒變吧」；Only…＝其實有變

notes.o: She used to be a fashion model.
notes.why: model 指模特兒，不是機型

notes.o: I need change for the vending machine.
notes.why: change 指零錢，不是規格改變

notes.o: Only the battery capacity, as far as I know.
notes.why: Only 表示只有電池容量有變 → 規格並非全沒變

key: Who 問人；「還沒決定」＝目前沒有人選

notes.o: It rolls out at the start of next quarter.
notes.why: 回答上線時間，不是誰

notes.o: I overlooked the last paragraph, sorry.
notes.why: overlooked 與 oversee 的 over 相近

notes.o: That hasn't been decided yet, as far as I know.
notes.why: 還沒決定 → 目前沒有人選

key: 問走路到得了嗎；提接駁車＝暗示走路不方便

notes.o: There's a free shuttle every fifteen minutes.
notes.why: 有免費接駁車 → 暗示距離遠，走路不太方便

notes.o: I've been working there for a decade.
notes.why: 工作十年與場地距離無關

notes.o: The conference call went well.
notes.why: 重複 conference，講電話會議，沒答距離

key: How did…react 問反應；聽對方的態度

notes.o: I figured it out by myself, thanks.
notes.why: figured 與 figures 發音相近

notes.o: They want a more detailed breakdown before they commit.
notes.why: 說出反應：想先看更詳細的明細才表態

notes.o: The preliminary round starts at nine.
notes.why: 重複 preliminary，講預賽時間

key: 陳述句抱怨難用 → 選提供協助

notes.o: There's a tutorial video on the staff portal.
notes.why: 提供教學影片，回應軟體難上手

notes.o: I hope the weather improves by Friday.
notes.why: hope 重複，講天氣，沒回應軟體

notes.o: That restaurant is far too expensive.
notes.why: expensive 與 expense 發音相近

key: Didn't…unanimously 確認一致；Actually＝其實不是

notes.o: Two members voted against it, actually.
notes.why: Actually 糾正：其實有兩位投反對票

notes.o: The expansion will add two new floors.
notes.why: 重複 expansion，講擴建樓層，沒答表決

notes.o: The cutting board is in the kitchen.
notes.why: board 指砧板，不是董事會

key: 陳述句說新規定 → 選配合規定的作法

notes.o: Then I'll switch my client visit to a video call.
notes.why: 配合規定：把出差改成視訊

notes.o: The curtains in the lobby look new.
notes.why: curtains 與 curtail 發音相近，講窗簾

notes.o: A quarter past three would suit me.
notes.why: quarter 指十五分，不是季度

key: A or B 問句；Neither＝兩者都不是

notes.o: I got approval from my supervisor.
notes.why: approval 與 appraisal 發音相近

notes.o: Yes, the office is open on Saturdays.
notes.why: A or B 問句不能用 Yes 回答

notes.o: Neither, we've moved it online.
notes.why: Neither 兩個都不是，並說明改為線上

key: Can you 請求；答應並給出具體時間

notes.o: The presentation went very well, thank you.
notes.why: 簡報在週四，went 過去式時態不合

notes.o: Express delivery will get it to you by Wednesday.
notes.why: 答應加急：快遞星期三前送到

notes.o: The expedition lasted three weeks.
notes.why: expedition 與 expedite 發音相近

key: Do you think 問看法；Not unless＝有條件才行

notes.o: The line at the bank was very long.
notes.why: line 指排隊，不是 timeline 時程

notes.o: Not unless we get two more developers.
notes.why: Not unless 表示除非加人，否則時程不可行

notes.o: The time zone difference is eight hours.
notes.why: time 與 timeline 相近，講時差

key: A or B 問句；說現場不能用＝選外面

notes.o: The training room here is being renovated.
notes.why: 這裡訓練室整修中 → 暗示要在外面辦

notes.o: The workshop lasted about three hours.
notes.why: 重複 workshop，講時數，沒選地點

notes.o: I couldn't find the website.
notes.why: website 與 offsite 發音相近

key: 陳述句強調必須 → 選配合的行動

notes.o: The appliance store is having a sale.
notes.why: appliance 與 compliance 發音相近

notes.o: Nice to meet you, too.
notes.why: meet you 是見面，不是趕上期限

notes.o: Then I'll clear my schedule to finish the paperwork.
notes.why: 排開行程把文件弄完，回應必須趕上期限

key: Does…require 問要不要；Not for…＝不用

notes.o: We sat on the river bank for hours.
notes.why: bank 指河岸，不是銀行

notes.o: Not for established customers like us.
notes.why: Not 表示不用，因為我們是老客戶

notes.o: I'm all alone in the office today.
notes.why: alone 與 loan 發音相近

key: A or B 問句；用時間限制暗示選摘要

notes.o: The summer schedule starts in June.
notes.why: summer 與 summary 發音相近

notes.o: I only have five minutes before my next call.
notes.why: 只剩五分鐘 → 暗示只看得了簡短摘要

notes.o: Yes, the reporter interviewed him.
notes.why: reporter 與 report 相近；Yes 也不合

key: Is it feasible 問可不可行；Only if＝有條件才行

notes.o: Only if we hire extra movers.
notes.why: Only if 附條件：要多請搬運人員才可行

notes.o: The fees are listed on the last page.
notes.why: fees 與 feasible 前半音相近

notes.o: The warehouse is on Harbor Street.
notes.why: 重複 warehouse，講位置，沒答可行性

key: Could you 請求；說「還沒有」＝暫時辦不到

notes.o: The show starts at eight tonight.
notes.why: show 與 showroom 相近，講表演時間

notes.o: Go forward two blocks and turn left.
notes.why: forward 指往前，不是轉寄

notes.o: The architect hasn't released the final version.
notes.why: 最終版還沒釋出 → 暫時沒辦法轉寄

key: Where 問地點；「邀請裡都寫了」＝去看邀請

notes.o: I'd like a brief summary, please.
notes.why: brief 與 debrief 發音相近

notes.o: It's all in the calendar invitation I sent.
notes.why: 沒說地點，但邀請裡都寫了 → 去看邀請

notes.o: We traded shifts last weekend.
notes.why: traded 與 trade 相近，講換班

key: 陳述句報壞消息 → 選追問影響的回應

notes.o: Did they say how late the food will be?
notes.why: 追問會晚多久，關心餐點延誤

notes.o: The call lasted almost an hour.
notes.why: 重複 call，講通話時間，沒追問影響

notes.o: I'll take my break at two o'clock.
notes.why: break 與 broke 發音相近，講休息

key: 附加問句確認；提前一天＝確實在期限前

notes.o: The files are in the top cabinet.
notes.why: files 與 filed 相近，講檔案櫃

notes.o: Our attorney submitted it with a day to spare.
notes.why: 提前一天送出 → 確實在期限前送件

notes.o: Please be patient, it won't take long.
notes.why: patient 與 patent 發音相近

key: When 問時間；「視…而定」＝時間不確定

notes.o: Yes, the audio was much clearer this time.
notes.why: audio 與 auditors 發音相近；Yes 也不合

notes.o: It depends on how quickly we send the missing receipts.
notes.why: 要看收據多快送到 → 完成時間不確定

notes.o: In the accounting office on the third floor.
notes.why: accounting office 是地點，不是時間

key: Aren't you going to 問去不去；「派人代替」＝不去

notes.o: Good afternoon, may I take your order?
notes.why: 重複 afternoon，是招呼語，沒回答

notes.o: I intend to buy a new laptop.
notes.why: intend 與 attend 發音相近

notes.o: I'm sending my deputy in my place.
notes.why: 派副手代替我去 → 暗示自己不出席

key: Why don't we 是提議；說已有人選＝贊同

notes.o: I set up my new phone last night.
notes.why: 重複 set up，指設定手機，不是佈置攤位

notes.o: Ms. Ito has offered to take that on.
notes.why: 伊藤小姐已主動接下 → 贊同，且已有人選

notes.o: Because the boots were too tight.
notes.why: boots 與 booth 發音相近，且聽成問原因

key: Couldn't we 提議；說代價大＝不太可行

notes.o: Please shift the table to the left.
notes.why: shift 指移動，不是輪班

notes.o: The relay race starts at ten.
notes.why: relay 與 delay 發音相近

notes.o: That would entail hiring a lot more staff.
notes.why: 會需要多請很多人 → 暗示成本高、不容易

key: Don't we need 問需不需要；Only for…＝有條件才要

notes.o: Only for expenditures over five thousand dollars.
notes.why: Only for 表示只有超過五千才需要

notes.o: The direction signs are confusing.
notes.why: direction 與 director 發音相近

notes.o: He succeeded on his first try.
notes.why: succeeded 與 exceed 發音相近

key: Please make sure 請求；「我會準備好」＝答應

notes.o: The entry fee is five dollars.
notes.why: entry 與 entering 相近，講入場費

notes.o: The sign on the door says closed.
notes.why: sign 指牌子，不是簽到 sign in

notes.o: I'll have the log sheet ready at the front desk.
notes.why: 準備好登記表 → 答應讓訪客簽到

key: 陳述句報告問題 → 選處理動作

notes.o: The notice was posted yesterday.
notes.why: notice 與 noticed 相近，講公告

notes.o: That's against the safety code. I'll have them moved.
notes.why: 指出違規，並說會請人搬走

notes.o: The exit interview is scheduled for Monday.
notes.why: 重複 exit，指離職面談，沒回應堵住

key: Why don't we 提議；「不確定會更省」＝保留

notes.o: Because the outside door was locked.
notes.why: 重複 outside，講門鎖住，且聽成問原因

notes.o: Please press the button firmly.
notes.why: firmly 與 firm 相近，講用力按

notes.o: I'm not sure that would be cheaper in the long run.
notes.why: 不確定長期較省 → 對外包持保留態度

key: Would you mind 答 As long as＝同意但附條件

notes.o: As long as you can still join the team call.
notes.why: As long as 同意在外面工作，但要參加電話會議

notes.o: It works much better now.
notes.why: works 與 worked 相近，指運作順暢

notes.o: The sightseeing bus leaves at nine.
notes.why: sightseeing 與 offsite 的 site 相近

key: 附加問句求確認；說明原因＝同意

notes.o: He's much taller than his brother.
notes.why: 比較身高與扣款無關

notes.o: The new insurance premium took effect on the first.
notes.why: 新保險費生效 → 說明扣款增加的原因

notes.o: Payday is the twenty-fifth of each month.
notes.why: 發薪日與薪資相關，沒回應扣款變多

key: A or B 問句；「兩個都要」＝不選其一

notes.o: The chairperson will speak first.
notes.why: chairperson 的 chair 重複，講主席發言

notes.o: I can't stand waiting in long lines.
notes.why: stand 指忍受，不是站立式辦公桌

notes.o: Actually, I was hoping to get both.
notes.why: Actually 說兩樣都想要 → 不二選一

key: I heard 傳聞 → 選驚訝＋提出相反資訊

notes.o: It's physically demanding work.
notes.why: physically 與 fiscal 發音相近

notes.o: The finalists will be announced tomorrow.
notes.why: finalists 與 finalized 發音相近

notes.o: Really? I thought the board had already signed off.
notes.why: Really? 表示驚訝，並說原先以為已核准

key: Will…endorse 問會不會支持；「有疑慮」＝未必

notes.o: Support staff are available around the clock.
notes.why: 重複 support，講客服人員，沒答董事會

notes.o: We boarded the plane an hour late.
notes.why: boarded 指登機，不是董事會 board

notes.o: Several members have serious reservations.
notes.why: 多位董事有疑慮 → 暗示未必支持

key: 附加問句求確認；「邀請函這麼寫」＝是

notes.o: I need to replace a flat tire.
notes.why: tire 與 attire 發音相近

notes.o: The code for the door is four two one.
notes.why: 重複 code，講門的密碼

notes.o: That's what it says on the invitation.
notes.why: 邀請函上這麼寫 → 肯定是正式服裝

key: Which 問哪一個；「還沒篩選」＝還沒有名單

notes.o: They haven't narrowed it down yet.
notes.why: 還沒篩選出來 → 目前沒有候選名單

notes.o: In the lobby, next to the reception desk.
notes.why: 重複 lobby，講位置，沒指出承包商

notes.o: The contract is short, only two pages.
notes.why: contract 與 contractor 相近；short 與 shortlist 相近

key: Wasn't…scheduled 問原定計畫；說延後＝沒準時

notes.o: The rolls are fresh from the oven.
notes.why: rolls 與 rollout 發音相近

notes.o: It's the first door on your left.
notes.why: first door 是第一扇門，不是一號

notes.o: Testing uncovered a few bugs, so it's been delayed.
notes.why: 測試發現錯誤所以延後 → 沒有按原訂上線

key: 附加問句問是否負責；Only…＝只負責部分

notes.o: The accountant retired last year.
notes.why: accountant 與 accountable 發音相近

notes.o: Only for the east warehouse.
notes.why: Only 表示只負責東倉，不是全部

notes.o: The inventor won a national award.
notes.why: inventor 與 inventory 發音相近

key: Would you be able 請求；「寧願別人做」＝婉拒

notes.o: The medium size should fit you.
notes.why: medium 與 mediate 發音相近

notes.o: I'd rather someone neutral from human resources did it.
notes.why: 寧願讓中立的人來做 → 委婉拒絕

notes.o: The apartment is on the top floor.
notes.why: apartment 與 department 發音相近

key: A or B 問句；推給決策者＝自己不選

notes.o: That's at the finance director's discretion.
notes.why: 由財務總監決定 → 自己不替他選

notes.o: The market is open until six.
notes.why: market 與 marketing 相近，講市場營業時間

notes.o: He left the office about an hour ago.
notes.why: left 指離開，不是 leave（留下）

key: Isn't mandatory 確認規定；Yes＋補充細節

notes.o: I'll be back in ten minutes.
notes.why: back 與 back up 相近，指回來

notes.o: The server brought us the wrong dishes.
notes.why: server 指服務生，不是伺服器

notes.o: Yes, and the system does it automatically every night.
notes.why: Yes 確認規定，並補充每晚自動備份

key: A or B 問句；說理由暗示選包廂

notes.o: We'll be discussing some confidential figures.
notes.why: 要討論機密數字 → 暗示該訂包廂

notes.o: The main course comes with a salad.
notes.why: 重複 main，講主菜，沒選座位

notes.o: I've read that book twice.
notes.why: book 指書，不是訂位

key: A or B 問句；說已在做＝選找新場所

notes.o: He made a promise to call back.
notes.why: promise 與 premises 發音相近

notes.o: Yes, the news was on this morning.
notes.why: A or B 問句不能用 Yes 回答

notes.o: We've already started viewing other buildings.
notes.why: 已開始看其他大樓 → 選擇找新場所

key: Shouldn't we 問該不該；「已在做」＝同意

notes.o: The rice was a little dry.
notes.why: rice 與 risks 發音相近

notes.o: The consultants are already working on that.
notes.why: 顧問已在做 → 同意該評估，且已進行

notes.o: The access road is closed today.
notes.why: access 與 assess 發音相近

key: What's causing 問原因；「派人查」＝原因未明

notes.o: My connecting flight leaves in forty minutes.
notes.why: connecting 與 connectivity 發音相近

notes.o: A technician is coming to look into it this afternoon.
notes.why: 沒說原因，但派人來查 → 原因還在調查

notes.o: Yes, it's on the fourth floor.
notes.why: What 問句不能用 Yes 回答

key: 附加問句求確認；補充原因＝同意

notes.o: I couldn't reach him by phone.
notes.why: reach 與 outreach 發音相近

notes.o: The attendant will show you to your seat.
notes.why: attendant 與 attendance 發音相近

notes.o: The heavy rain kept a lot of people home.
notes.why: 說明出席少的原因：雨太大
